item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena hangs a steel paper clip from a thread and brings a bar magnet near it. The clip moves towards the magnet without the magnet touching it.
Later, she pushes her toy cart across the floor with her hand to make it move.
Which statement correctly classifies these two forces?

options.A: Both are contact forces, because in both cases something makes the object move.
options.B: Both are non-contact forces, because the paper clip and the cart both start moving.
options.C: The magnetic force is a contact force, while the muscular force on the cart is a non-contact force.
options.D: The magnetic force is a non-contact force, while the muscular force on the cart is a contact force.
